# Brand Context Map Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Upgrade `build-library-report` from a simple overview page into a static Brand Context Map with a clickable knowledge map, searchable explorer, taxonomy-aware categories, and item details.

**Architecture:** Keep the output as one offline HTML file generated by `src/brand_skill/library_report.py`. The Python layer reads taxonomy and markdown entries, builds a small JSON data model, then embeds it into the HTML. The browser layer uses plain JavaScript for click selection, keyword search, category/status filters, and detail rendering.

**Tech Stack:** Python standard library, Markdown files, static HTML/CSS/vanilla JavaScript, existing `unittest` suite.

---

## File Structure

- Modify `src/brand_skill/library_report.py`: parse taxonomy, collect entries, compute statuses, render map/explorer/detail UI, embed JSON.
- Modify `tests/test_phase1_workflow.py`: add focused tests for taxonomy parsing, map/explorer HTML, item summaries, and CLI compatibility.
- Modify `README.md`: update `build-library-report` description to Brand Context Map.
- Modify `docs/brand_context_library_architecture.md`: document optional `taxonomy.md` and dynamic categories.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement taxonomy parsing and entry collection**

In `src/brand_skill/library_report.py`, add:

```python
def _parse_taxonomy(library_dir: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    taxonomy_path = library_dir / "taxonomy.md"
    taxonomy = {
        section: {
            "id": section,
            "label": SECTION_LABELS.get(section, section),
            "description": "默认推荐分类",
            "source": "默认推荐",
            "status": "已启用",
        }
        for section in sorted(VALID_LIBRARY_DIRS)
    }
    if not taxonomy_path.exists():
        return taxonomy

    lines = [line.strip() for line in taxonomy_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("|")]
    rows = _parse_markdown_table(lines)
    for row in rows:
        category_id = row.get("分类 ID", "").strip()
        if not category_id:
            continue
        taxonomy[category_id] = {
            "id": category_id,
            "label": row.get("展示名称", category_id).strip() or category_id,
            "description": row.get("说明", "").strip(),
            "source": row.get("来源", "").strip() or "AI 建议",
            "status": row.get("状态", "").strip() or "待确认",
        }
    return taxonomy


def _parse_markdown_table(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    if len(lines) < 2:
        return []
    parsed = [[cell.strip() for cell in line.strip("|").split("|")] for line in lines]
    parsed = [row for row in parsed if not all(set(cell) <= {"-", ":"} for cell in row)]
    if len(parsed) < 2:
        return []
    header = parsed[0]
    return [dict(zip(header, row)) for row in parsed[1:] if len(row) == len(header)]


def _collect_entries(library_dir: Path, taxonomy: dict[str, dict[str, str]]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    entries = []
    category_ids = set(taxonomy) | {path.name for path in library_dir.iterdir() if path.is_dir()}
    for category_id in sorted(category_ids):
        category_dir = library_dir / category_id
        if not category_dir.is_dir() or category_id in {"review_queue", "retrieval_maps"}:
            continue
        for markdown_path in sorted(category_dir.glob("*.md")):
            text = markdown_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            entries.append(
                {
                    "id": markdown_path.stem,
                    "title": _first_heading(text) or markdown_path.stem,
                    "summary": _extract_summary(text),
                    "category": category_id,
                    "categoryLabel": taxonomy.get(category_id, {}).get("label", category_id),
                    "path": str(markdown_path.relative_to(library_dir)),
                    "status": "正常",
                }
            )
    return entries


def _first_heading(markdown: str) -> str:
    for line in markdown.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("# "):
            return line[2:].strip()
    return ""


def _extract_summary(markdown: str) -> str:
    lines = markdown.splitlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.strip() == "## 内容摘要":
            summary_lines = []
            for next_line in lines[index + 1:]:
                if next_line.startswith("## "):
                    break
                if next_line.strip():
                    summary_lines.append(next_line.strip())
            return " ".join(summary_lines).strip()
    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped and not stripped.startswith("#") and not stripped.startswith("-"):
            return stripped
    return "暂无摘要。"
```

Update `build_library_report()` to call `_parse_taxonomy()` and `_collect_entries()`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement vanilla JavaScript interactions**

Add inline script with these functions:

```javascript
const libraryData = window.__BRAND_CONTEXT_LIBRARY__;
const searchInput = document.querySelector('[data-role="searchInput"]');
const categoryFilter = document.querySelector('[data-role="categoryFilter"]');
const statusFilter = document.querySelector('[data-role="statusFilter"]');
const explorerList = document.querySelector('[data-role="explorerList"]');
const detailPanel = document.querySelector('[data-role="detailPanel"]');

function renderExplorer() {
  const keyword = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const category = categoryFilter.value;
  const status = statusFilter.value;
  const entries = libraryData.entries.filter((entry) => {
    const matchesKeyword = !keyword || `${entry.title} ${entry.summary} ${entry.categoryLabel}`.toLowerCase().includes(keyword);
    const matchesCategory = category === 'all' || entry.category === category;
    const matchesStatus = status === 'all' || entry.status === status;
    return matchesKeyword && matchesCategory && matchesStatus;
  });
  explorerList.innerHTML = entries.map((entry) => `<button type="button" data-entry-id="${escapeHtml(entry.id)}">${escapeHtml(entry.title)}<span>${escapeHtml(entry.categoryLabel)}</span></button>`).join('') || '<p class="muted">没有匹配的知识条目。</p>';
}

function selectEntry(entryId) {
  const entry = libraryData.entries.find((item) => item.id === entryId);
  if (!entry) return;
  detailPanel.innerHTML = `<h2>${escapeHtml(entry.title)}</h2><p>${escapeHtml(entry.summary)}</p><dl><dt>分类</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(entry.categoryLabel)}</dd><dt>文件路径</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(entry.path)}</dd><dt>状态</dt><dd>${escapeHtml(entry.status)}</dd></dl>`;
}

function escapeHtml(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (char) => ({'&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;'}[char]));
}
```

Attach listeners for `input`, `change`, and explorer/map clicks.
